import json, os
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta

paths=[
 os.path.expanduser("~/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/data/task_provenance.jsonl"),
 os.path.expanduser("~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_inbox.jsonl"),

  print(f"\n== {p} exists={os.path.exists(p)} ==")
  if not os.path.exists(p):
    continue
  n=0
  with open(p,'r',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace') as f:
    for line in f:
      line=line.strip()
      if not line: continue
      try:
        o=json.loads(line)
      except: continue
      # time fields
      ts=o.get('ts') or o.get('time') or o.get('created_at') or o.get('received_at') or o.get('timestamp') or ''
      s=str(ts)
      if day not in s and not s.startswith(day.replace('-','')):
        # try epoch
        try:
          t=float(ts)
          if t>1e12: t/=1000
          s=datetime.fromtimestamp(t,TZ).strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
        except: 
          continue
      if not s.startswith(day):
        continue
      n+=1
      if n<=30:
        src=o.get('source') or o.get('from') or o.get('kind') or ''
        text=(o.get('text') or o.get('prompt') or o.get('summary') or o.get('body') or o.get('message') or '')
        if isinstance(text,dict): text=str(text)
        text=str(text).replace('\n',' ')[:180]
        print(f"{s} | {src} | bus={o.get('bus_id') or o.get('id') or ''} | {text}")
  print(f"count={n}")
PY
